sessions.title: Market Research Sprint: First Picks
sessions.objective: Execute SOP-018 end-to-end to produce 3-5 market research picks using existing methods and WebSearch/WebFetch, breaking the zero-output streak that has persisted for 14+ team sessions.

sop_023_compliance.justification: 4 of 5 agents on domain work (research + analysis), 1 on documentation/indexing. Zero infrastructure work. This is a pure execution session.

tasks: Gather macro backdrop (S&P 500, VIX, Fed, inflation)
Gather news sentiment from multiple sources
Merge findings from both research teams
Score candidates on valuation, growth, moat, sentiment, risk
Apply second-method validation per SOP-018 step 5
Create 1 KB entry documenting methodology and results

team_composition.think_tank_coding_ratio: 0:0 (no think tanks or coding teams -- this is a pure research/execution session)

deliverables.measurable: Files exist with all required fields per TEMPLATE.md
All new picks indexed with IDs

deliverables.location: Embedded in pick files and KB entry
deliverables.measurable: 200+ word market conditions analysis
Domain KB entry documenting research methodology and results
Log with actual domain/infra/overhead split

prerequisites: None. All tools exist. WebSearch and WebFetch are built into Claude. Methods are documented in market-research/methods/. TEMPLATE.md is ready. This session has ZERO dependencies.

risk_factors.mitigation: Coordinator enforces zero infrastructure work. If any agent proposes building a tool first, redirect immediately. The Alpha report confirms all needed tools exist.
Financial data is widely available on Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, Google Finance via WebSearch. Alpha report confirms HIGH confidence for fundamental + sentiment methods.
Time-box sector screening to 10 min, stock screening to 15 min. Pick the best available, not the perfect candidate.

sessions.success_criteria: At least 3 pick files written to market-research/picks/ with all required fields. This is the minimum viable output.

sessions.objective: Add 2-3 financial MCP servers to .mcp.json for instant financial data access, build the pick_logger tool, and produce 3-5 additional market picks using the improved data pipeline.

sop_023_compliance.justification: 3 of 5 agents on domain work (research + pick logging tool which directly enables domain output). 1 agent on MCP integration (infrastructure but domain-enabling). 1 on documentation. MCP servers are ADOPT not BUILD -- minimal infra effort.

sop_023_compliance.justification: 3 of 5 agents on domain work (sector research, SEC data analysis, pick writing). 1 agent builds SEC EDGAR tool (domain-enabling per FREEZE-02 -- this unblocks fundamental analysis depth). 1 on documentation.

sop_023_compliance.justification: 3 of 5 agents on domain work (portfolio review is domain work -- analyzing actual pick performance). 1 agent on infrastructure bug fixes (allowed per FREEZE-03). 1 on documentation. Infrastructure fixes are all bug fixes to existing code, not new modules.

sessions.title: Agent Skills + Expanded Domain Output
sessions.objective: Package the proven market research workflow as a reusable Agent Skill, build the FRED data-gathering tool for macro analysis, and produce an economic analysis report alongside 3-5 new picks.

sop_023_compliance.justification: 3 of 5 agents on domain work (economic analysis, new picks, domain KB entries). 1 agent builds FRED tool + packages Agent Skill (both domain-enabling). 1 on documentation. The Agent Skill packages existing domain workflow -- it is domain tooling, not coordination infrastructure.

critical_constraints_summary.session_1_must_produce_picks: Non-negotiable. The zero-output streak must end. Session 1 has zero prerequisites and zero infrastructure dependencies.
critical_constraints_summary.no_new_sops: Per SOP-023 FREEZE-01, no new SOPs unless a genuinely novel failure mode is encountered during these 5 sessions.
critical_constraints_summary.no_new_coordination_modules: Per SOP-023 FREEZE-02, no modifications to coordination system beyond bug fixes (FREEZE-03 allows fixes).
critical_constraints_summary.infrastructure_cap: Max 1 infrastructure agent per session (Sessions 2-5). Session 1 has zero.
critical_constraints_summary.tool_building_is_time_boxed: Each tool (pick_logger, SEC EDGAR, FRED) gets 1 agent for 1 session. If not complete, it ships as-is and iterates later.
